items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: So I called. I said, Mr. Hennig, come here. How much you want for this pipe horn right in the door?

ctx.x: That was an alto horn or an alto sax?

Alto horn. I could've been a good alto sax player, but I didn't know. I went uptown to get some reeds from the tag at Grunewald, you know? I used to go up there and get a dollar with a reed at once. And when I come out, I seen horn, seen alto sax in the show cave. So I called. I said, Mr. Hennig, come here. How much you want for this pipe horn right in the door? What's a pipe horn? I said, come here and let me show you. He said, that's the alto sax. I let you have it for $60. What section of the city did you live…
What section of the city did you live in?
